headline: Commandos Behind Enemy Lines
title: Commandos Behind Enemy Lines Facts | Tiny Team Big Hit | Classic Games
video_script: Commandos Behind Enemy Lines came out in nineteen ninety eight from Spanish studio Pyro Studios. About eighteen people built it in roughly eighteen months. The makers reportedly hoped to sell around fifteen thousand copies, but it passed one million. You control six commandos across twenty missions, using stealth and planning. Was this the hardest game you ever played? Comment below!
description: Commandos Behind Enemy Lines (1998, Pyro Studios): about 18 developers, six commandos, twenty missions, expected modest sales but sold over a million.
